    The Euler form on an interval with two points #

    The inverse Cartan matrix is supported on the path order (cartan_inv_support). If b is reached from a with dim e_b A e_a = 1 and no third point lies on a path from a to b, then ⟨e_a, e_b⟩ + ⟨e_b, e_a⟩ = -1, a full edge of the Euler form (eulerForm_c_interval).

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.AR.cartan_inv_support {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] (D : DirData k A) (hT : ∀ (x : D.ι), x ∈ D.T) (i j : D.ι) :
    (cartan D)⁻¹ j i ≠ 0 → Relation.ReflTransGen D.Arr i j

    The inverse Cartan matrix is supported on the path order.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.AR.eulerForm_c_interval {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] (D : DirData k A) (hT : ∀ (x : D.ι), x ∈ D.T) {a b : D.ι} (hab : a ≠ b) (hba : cartan D b a = 1) (hint : ∀ (y : D.ι), y ≠ a → y ≠ b → Relation.ReflTransGen D.Arr a y → Relation.ReflTransGen D.Arr y b → False) :
    (eulerForm D hT).c a b = -1

    Paths of a quotient are paths of the algebra.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.AR.DirData.eulerForm_c_quot_interval {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] {D : DirData k A} {T' : Set D.ι} (hsub : T' ⊆ D.T) {a b : D.ι} (ha : a ∈ T') (hb : b ∈ T') (hab : a ≠ b) {c : A} (hc : D.e b * c * D.e a ≠ 0) (hle : cartan D b a ≤ 1) (hmid : ∀ (v : D.ι), Relation.ReflTransGen D.Arr a v → Relation.ReflTransGen D.Arr v b → v = a ∨ v = b) :
    (eulerForm (D.quotAny hsub) ⋯).c ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ = -1

    An edge of the quotient: if e_b A e_a is one-dimensional and nonzero, and every point on a path from a to b is a or b, then a, b are joined by a full edge of the Euler form of the quotient by the idempotents outside any T' ∋ a, b.
